inventory.principle: Every one of the indexed 25 deep research tracks appears in Step 3. The current inventory's status, evidence summary and gaps are rendered directly at runtime rather than copied.

additional.title: From political donations to federal business
additional.summary: Two company case studies and official exact-UEI Treasury transactions, not evidence of causation.
additional.missing: No donor-to-award decision join, procurement controls or causal attribution.

additional.title: Businesses, donors and government customers
additional.summary: Eight named businesses with FEC PAC and Treasury recipient identifiers; legal entities are not assumed identical.
additional.missing: Subsidiary/parent matching and comparable non-donor businesses.

additional.title: Government contracts by award and year
additional.summary: Fiscal 2018–partial 2027 prime contract actions for two exact registered recipient UEIs.
additional.missing: No matched political contributions, all-affiliates rollups or local contract beneficiaries.

additional.title: Company employee PAC filings
additional.summary: Original FEC committee-cycle summaries and independently labeled secondary candidate excerpt.
additional.missing: No fully reconciled FEC filing-item transfer path to agency decisions.

additional.title: Federal political committee registry
additional.summary: Official indexed FEC committee IDs, affiliations and reporting periods—not donor transactions.
additional.missing: A registered committee is not proof its funds changed government decisions.

additional.title: Sixteen ways to change influence rules
additional.summary: Four-pillar reform options: transparency, safeguards, civic empowerment and enforcement. Proposals are not current law.
additional.missing: No universal local effect estimate or endorsed option.

additional.title: Actual government accountability actions
additional.summary: Selected official-source oversight cases and two recorded 2026 congressional votes; not exhaustive.
additional.missing: No complete national record of enforcement or individual benefit.

additional.title: Polling, investments and wealth evidence
additional.summary: Source registry tying public polling archives and selected legislative holdings; joint causal models not ready.
additional.missing: Respondent-level survey joins, all elected official trades, price-impact identification.

additional.title: Public institutional relationship network
additional.summary: Published coverage index reports 2,619 source-indexed institutional relationships; not a verified causal network or individually reviewed local connections.
additional.missing: Source-edge proof, linked decisions and household consequences require independent auditing. The detailed network file is not reliably readable through the current connector.

evidenceLevels.partial: Source-indexed / incomplete — useful leads or selected records, not full local attribution
evidenceLevels.curated: Selected reviewed or attributed records — not a nationwide census
evidenceLevels.needs_data: Research question indexed — no verified comparative local result yet

safeguards: No home-location or voting-preference tracking: ZIP input stays in page memory only, is not sent to Power Atlas, and never used to infer political preference.
ZIP codes may cross legislative, utility, school and municipal jurisdictions; a ZIP alone cannot name a responsible local official or apply state law.
Issue relevance is an editorial source navigation tag, never evidence that the named actor or dataset caused a local outcome.
Source paths, current research status and known gaps must be visible in Step 3; missing data is not zero and cannot justify invented local statistics.
Political donations, lobbying, business awards, corporate profits, voting records and court decisions are distinct records; joining them requires entity IDs, dates and documented decisions.
Policy options, resident participation tools and practical assistance are presented without partisan endorsements and with their jurisdictional limitations.
interpretation: Deep research library, not a personalized causal ranking of people, parties, companies or billionaires.

sourceDirectories.name: U.S. Senate lobbying disclosure
sourceDirectories.limitation: Lobbying registration is not evidence of a favorable policy result.

sourceDirectories.name: State election-office directory

sourceDirectories.name: State and local governments

sourceDirectories.name: Federal Judicial Center judges

sourceDirectories.limitation: Complaints are allegations, not adjudicated violations.

sourceDirectories.name: Federal Trade Commission
sourceDirectories.limitation: Investigation or lawsuit is not itself proof of misconduct.

sourceDirectories.name: National Center for Education Statistics

sourceDirectories.name: Housing and Urban Development

sourceDirectories.name: FollowTheMoney

sourceDirectories.name: CourtListener

sourceDirectories.name: OpenCorporates

sourceDirectories.name: OpenSanctions

sourceDirectoryNotes: Original public systems and investigative research references identified across the project. Being listed means link/reference, NOT paid access, ingestion, legal authorization, entity match or a proven causal connection.

Legally identified officials, donors and counterparties
